content.thinking: The variable A shadows module A in feasibility function (local name A parameter). Rename module alias. Let me fix by renaming import alias to AN.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && sed -i 's/import analyze as A/import analyze as AN/; s/norm=A\.validate/norm=AN.validate/' dev/study.py
sed -i 's/def feas(s,A):/def feas(s,Aset):/; s/key=(s,A)/key=(s,Aset)/; s/sol=snapshot_solver(B,None,s,A)/sol=snapshot_solver(B,None,s,Aset)/' dev/study.py
timeout 600 python3 dev/study.py 2>&1 | tail -20
